title: Maximal-order scalable stress corpus
objective: Expand the durable maximal-order corpus with exact high-degree, deep-index, wild-small-prime, and many-prime stress families without changing arithmetic algorithms

oracles: exact resultant and power-basis transition identities

handoff.summary: Adds eleven exact digest-only scalable stress records: four degree-112--160 bad generators, two degree-32 depth-512/2048 generators, three wild-at-2 scaled generators, and two many-prime scaled generators. Exact resultant/transition formulas, deterministic local proof states, bounded GP HNF/discriminant evidence, structural regeneration checks, and opt-in profiler selection are all durable.
risks: Sage and Hecke were unavailable on the regeneration host, so the eleven new cases have PARI plus construction-identity evidence but no new independent cross-family lattice agreement.
The largest k=2048 record has a 295,949-digit index and is intentionally opt-in; loading the whole corpus remains suitable for structural tests but not tiny startup paths.
next_steps: Run selected high-degree and deep-index cases through Sage/Hecke on a provisioned oracle host and append only completed bounded outcomes.
Use the stress profile to measure OM/MaxMin and parallel-local scaling without copying polynomial definitions into benchmark policy.
